utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Rosa, quick repair drive update: we’re gathering repair needs and tool volunteers, and Dane heard the first push is the shed roof and some porch rails.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Vik — I’ll note those, but I’m still matching the basics for Sunday at the community center: small fixes, mending, sharpening, and simple bike or appliance troubleshooting.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Got it, Rosa — Sunday at the community center is basics like small fixes, mending, sharpening, and simple bike or appliance troubleshooting; I’ll pass that along with the shed roof and porch rails note.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Pia, we’ve set Saturday the 15th at nine; I’m keeping the checklist simple, so please tell me what tools, parts, or bins you can confirm.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I thought Quinn had said 10 to 2 at the community center, so before I confirm anything, can we check with Tess whether it’s really nine on the 15th? Once the time is settled, I can help sort bins and avoid duplicating tools.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’s sensible, Pia; I’ll check with Tess before we lock the time, and for now I’ll mark you as tentative for sorting bins once it’s confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I don’t have much to spare right now, Nell, but I can sort tools or carry supplies if that helps the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That sounds helpful, Uli—Quinn said it’s Saturday 10 to 2 at the community center, and Rosa’s matching needs with volunteers, so I’ll pass along that you can sort tools or carry supplies.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Nell. I’ll be there Saturday at 10 and check in with Rosa, then keep to sorting or carrying wherever she needs me.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Kira, I’ve got Saturday the 15th at nine confirmed, but I still need to check with Eli or Leo before I say the final repair list or drop-off spot.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Saturday the 15th at nine is confirmed by whom, Oren? I’d rather wait until Eli or Leo verifies the repair list and drop-off spot before we pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: By Eli, I’m pretty sure—though let’s keep only the date and time as confirmed for now, and I’ll check with Eli or Leo before sharing the list or drop-off spot.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Rey, I’m still waiting on Ira for the confirmed repair list and drop-off spot. For now, just stay ready and I’ll pass it along once I have it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Leo — I’ll stay ready and won’t spread any details until the list and drop-off spot are confirmed. I’m also checking with Mina so we don’t double up on tools.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good plan, Rey. Check with Mina, but hold off on moving anything until Ira confirms the list and drop-off spot.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Ira — I’m still double-checking the final time because I’ve heard a conflicting 10-to-2 note, but the plan I’ve been working from is 3:30 to 6, with Faye helping set up after pickup until about 5:30.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Jules—I’ll hold off passing that along until Eli or Leo confirms the final time, repair list, and drop-off spot.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That sounds perfect, thanks Ira — I’ll check in with Quinn and Rosa too, and I’ll let you know as soon as we’ve got one clear set of details.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hi Mara, I’ve got two toolboxes, the spare drill, a full bit set, and a heavy-duty extension cord set aside already; I’m just waiting on the confirmed repair list and drop-off spot before bringing them over.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Gus — I’ll mark you down for two toolboxes, the spare drill, full bit set, and heavy-duty extension cord. The repair list is still being confirmed, and I’ll let you know the drop-off spot as soon as we settle it.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Perfect, thanks Mara — I’ll keep everything set aside and won’t haul it over until you send the final list and drop-off spot.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hi Mina — I’m keeping the supply list by the shed, and we’re starting with roof patching gear and porch rail materials first.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good—what exactly do we still need for roof patching and porch rails, and should I mark Gus’s drill, bit set, and extension cord as covered on the shed list?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes, mark Gus’s drill, bit set, and extension cord as covered; we still need tar paper, roofing nails, a couple patch boards, rail brackets, exterior screws, and any spare sandpaper folks can bring.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Hi Tess, I’m updating the repair drive location list—do you have any checked locations for tools, parts, or drop-off bins that I can mark as confirmed?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Not confirmed yet, Opal — I’m checking with the organizers today on the date, repair list, time window, and confirmed spots for tools, parts, and drop-off bins, and I’ll pass along anything solid as soon as I hear.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Tess — I’ll leave all of those pending for now and only mark them confirmed once you’ve heard back from the organizers.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Hey Quinn—I think we’re still collecting what needs fixing and who can bring tools, but I haven’t heard a confirmed repair list or drop-off spot yet.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Noah — I’d heard Saturday 10 to 2 at the community center with no sign-up, but Tess is double-checking the time and details today, so I’ll circle back once she confirms.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Quinn—I'll hold off on telling folks that as definite until Tess confirms. If I hear anything from Eli or Leo too, I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hi Faye, I’m set to help Saturday the 15th at nine with snacks, sign-ups, and checking the drop-off spots. I’m still waiting for Leo to pass along Ira’s confirmed repair list and final drop-off details.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Sam — I’m planning around school pickup, so I’m mainly set for the 3:30 to 5:30 stretch if that window still holds. Please send Leo and Ira’s final list and drop-off details when you get them.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, Faye — I’ll pass along Leo and Ira’s final list and drop-off details as soon as I get them, and I’ll keep your 3:30 to 5:30 window in mind.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Hana, I’m still likely getting there a bit late, but Cleo asked me to check in by the shed when I arrive. Last I heard, they’re starting with the shed roof and porch rails, then I’ll help sort tools or haul materials where it’s backed up.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Dane—I’ll note you as a likely late helper by the shed, unconfirmed until you arrive. Do you know how urgent the shed roof and porch rails are, and whether Cleo already has materials lined up?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m not sure on the urgency beyond Cleo naming them as the first push, and I haven’t heard whether materials are fully lined up. I’d mark that as something to confirm with Cleo by the shed.
